description: OiiOii is the world's first AI agent for animated and live-action video creation. Simply describe your idea, and OiiOii's cinematic professional agent team will instantly turn fragmented concepts into complete stories, advertisements, and finished videos. OiiOii also deeply integrates short-form comic drama workflows, enabling one-click completion of video stylization for global markets, script localization, multi-episode breakdown, and final production.

display.description_zh: OiiOii 是全球首个 AI 动画/真人视频创作 Agent。只需描述创意，OiiOii 的影视级专业 Agents 团队就会即刻将零散的想法转化为完整的故事、广告成片；同时，OiiOii 还深度整合短漫剧工作流，无论是视频转绘出海、剧本本土化出海、多剧集拆分到成片，都能一键完成。
examples_en: Help me create a short story: a transfer student arrives at a high school in another world and discovers that all the other students have different superpowers.
Create a 30-second animated promotional video based on this product introduction.
Expand this story script into a vertical-format AI live-action-style series and generate the first episode.
Using the uploaded character reference images, create a multi-shot animation with consistent character appearances.
Adapt this educational material into an animated explainer video suitable for middle school students.
Design a 45-second opening cinematic for this game.
Adapt this brand story into an animated short film with narration, music, and sound effects.
examples_zh: 帮我做个小故事：一个转学生来到异世界高中，发现同学们都有各种超能力
根据这份产品介绍，制作一条 30 秒的动画宣传片。
把这个故事脚本扩展成一部竖屏 AI 仿真人剧，并生成第一集。
根据上传的角色参考图，制作一段角色形象一致的多镜头动画。
将这份教育材料改编成适合中学生观看的动画讲解视频。
为这款游戏设计一段 45 秒的开场过场动画。
把这篇品牌故事改编成包含旁白、音乐和音效的动画短片。
